'''General'''

The quickest way to earn lots of money in [[GTA: San Andreas]] is to save the game then go gamble your life savings at one of the betting shops. If you lose, re-load the game and go bet on the same horse again. Repeat the process until you can afford all the clothes, guns and houses you want. It should only take 4 or 5 visits.

'''Notes'''

The closest [[safe house]] and [[Inside Track]] Betting Shop together are the [[Jefferson Safehouse]] in [[Glen Park]] and the betting shop in [[Downtown Los Santos in GTA III Era|Downtown Los Santos]] under the [[Mulholland Intersection]]. You don't have to use these locations, but it saves time. The glen park house has no garage so you'll have to steal a cab outside.

'''Instructions'''

# Enter a [[safe house]] and save the game
# Drive to the nearest [[Inside Track]] and go in
# Go to a booth and place a bet on the highest odds runner
# If you lose, then load up the game from the [[safe house]] and go back to [[Inside Track]]
# Once you win, save the game again at the [[safe house]] and go place all of your money on the horse again
